observed: The cold cumulative RSS peak is not higher in c0. Its end-cold estimated managed memory is about90 MiB higher, with one fewer gen2 collection.
RSS grows during the warm phases; c0 performs a gen2 collection during warm-2 evidence processing and its estimated managed memory falls by about82 MiB.

The entire final RSS peak is already present at the source-cache-reset checkpoint before reset evidence allocation/writing in every run. This interval also includes cache invalidation and parent setup.
At reset end, c0 estimated managed memory is about31 MiB lower, but current RSS is about20 MiB higher and last-GC fragmentation about43 MiB higher. Most last-GC fragmentation is in the LOH.
diagnosis.inference: The observations are consistent with changed collection timing and LOH fragmentation/commit behavior creating a transient reset peak. Reduced allocated bytes can shift GC thresholds. They do not establish an additional75 MiB of live retained library objects.
limits: GCMemoryInfo describes the last completed GC, not an instantaneous live-object census. GetTotalMemory(false) is an estimate and can include uncollected garbage.
No forced GC, allocation trace or heap-root analysis was used. The exact allocation producing the transient peak is not identified.
Instrumentation is confined to tests and changes observer allocations slightly; diagnostic timings must not enter the main performance report.
The diagnostic applies only to the c0add0a experiment (helper plus guard memo), not to the later helper-only candidate.
